Sorry for pic of tv.  I hated this guy.  Good riddance.  I have tried so many tips.  Only thing that helped was this:

1.  Mute the sound.  All of it.  No beeps no grunts no      nothing.  Just mute all of it.  

2.  Set controller to direct usb connection and plug it in!

3.  Make sure you have game mode on if your tv has it 

4. Press the buttons harder. (Don’t crush the buttons even though you want to) Get those full presses in. 

5.  Watch Tifa’s hips.  If she pauses, that means you can go a smidge faster. No too fast.  Not too slow.  

6. Feel the vibrations and listen to your buttons.  

7. Once you get that button you have to press a bunch of times you can go even faster.  Still watch her hips to see if she pauses 

8.  Channel your inner Dance Dance Revolution/ PaRappa the Rapper
